title: MORTIMER: Multi-asset Optimisation and Risk Targeting with Integrated Monthly E6 Rebalancing
identity: MORTIMER is the frozen long-only, volatility-targeted ERC portfolio.

base.rebalance: Known month-end session decision, next-close execution

forecast.method: max EWMA squared current-base portfolio returns

overlay.restoration: Same causal target and symmetric event trigger; no discretionary stop

execution.fill: Close t+1 after that session return

splits.boundary_rule: Shorter of most recent20% of actual observed sessions and most recent2calendar years

metric_conventions.volatility: Sample standard deviation of raw daily net returns times sqrt252
metric_conventions.sharpe: Mean daily excess over recorded cash times252 divided by raw-return annual volatility
metric_conventions.turnover: Annualised half-L1 risky and cash weight change

controls: Matched unscaled ERC on identical samples; original recorded static/nearby diagnostics remain in the archival protocol
capital_risk: No leverage or shorts; .35 target-base name cap, cash remainder, .10 risk target. Exposure and weights drift between executions; no newly introduced stop or sector constraint. Original loss/stress diagnostics retained.

evaluation.protocol: Training, validation, and held-out OOS test; the frozen specification was evaluated once on the OOS test.
